parameters.name: AlbRules
parameters.description: The canary rules for an application that uses an ALB gateway route.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the canary rule. The description can be up to 64 characters long.

parameters.name: DubboRules
parameters.description: The canary rules for a Dubbo application. This parameter is required for Dubbo applications and cannot be used with the **ScRules** parameter.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the canary rule. The name can be up to 64 characters long and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and Chinese characters. It must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.

parameters.name: ScRules
parameters.description: The canary rules for a Spring Cloud application. This parameter is required for Spring Cloud applications and cannot be used with the **DubboRules** parameter.
